sentences.text: In this petition, the petitioner has challenged the validity of the order dated 7.2.2015 passed by the Additional Collector by imposing a fine of Rs.40,000/- on the petitioner under the provisions of the Food Standard and Safety Act, 2006.
Against the aforesaid order an appeal lies.
However, he submits that the appellate authority has not been constituted.
In view of the aforesaid, learned counsel for petitioner prays for adjournment in order to enable him to apprise this Court whether the appellate authority under Act 2006 is constituted.
As prayed, let the writ petition be listed in the next week.

(ALOK ARADHE) JUDGE Sanat Singhai vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 29 April, 2015 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/85332647/
